title: Visit to a Cemetery (November 1–8)
scope: Applicable only to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Devoutly visit a cemetery and pray, if only mentally, for the deceased.
description: A plenary indulgence, applicable only to the souls in purgatory, is granted to the faithful who devoutly visit a cemetery and pray for the departed during November 1 through 8.

title: Recitation of the Marian Rosary
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Recite five decades of the Rosary in a church, public oratory, or in a family, religious community, or pious association.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted if the Rosary is recited in a church or public oratory, or in a family, religious community, or association of the faithful.

title: Adoration of the Most Blessed Sacrament
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Visit the Most Blessed Sacrament for Eucharistic adoration for at least 30 minutes.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted to the faithful who visit the Most Blessed Sacrament for adoration for at least half an hour.

title: Reading of Sacred Scripture
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Read Sacred Scripture as spiritual reading with veneration due to the divine word for at least 30 minutes.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted to the faithful who read Sacred Scripture with the veneration due to the divine word for at least half an hour.

title: Exercise of the Way of the Cross
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Perform the pious exercise of the 14 Stations of the Cross before legitimately erected stations, moving from station to station and meditating on the Passion.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted to the faithful who perform the pious exercise of the Way of the Cross.

title: Recitation of Veni Creator Spiritus (January 1)
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Devoutly recite or sing the hymn Veni Creator Spiritus in a church or oratory on New Year's Day.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted to the faithful who devoutly recite or sing the hymn Veni Creator Spiritus on the first day of the year to implore divine assistance for the coming year.

title: Adoration of the Cross (Good Friday)
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Sacramental Confession
Eucharistic Communion
Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Devoutly assist at the solemn liturgical action of Good Friday and venerate the Holy Cross.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted to the faithful who, during the solemn liturgical action of Good Friday, devoutly participate in the adoration of the Cross and kiss it.
